main_text.p: da multitudo Philippopolim verfus euntis, frigore enicata fit. vti Petrus iterum dux Europæi exerci-tus ab Imperatore fit ordinatus,deq; nuptiis Theo-dosij filij Mauritij cum filia Germani. deq; anno-næ caritate in vrbe regia, deque concurfu acturba populi in templo fupplicante Cæsare, ciusque le-nitate, exilioque militum, Eorumque post vnum diem reditu. quomodo Mauricius Petrum miserit, vt quocunque modo militem Thracicum in alte-ram Iftri partem transfretaret, quomodoque vox diuina Petro fit locuta, ac tumultu in exercitu co-orto Romano, tyrannis contra Imperatorem nata fit, tyranno Phoca à militibus Imperatore Saluta-to.quomodo fugerit Petrus tumultusq; ad regem delatus,& quomodo primum per tribunos Plebei Sergium & Cosman plebs diftracta, ac inuenti fint Praefinorum M. D. Venetorum verò c c c. & quo-modo inter populum æmulatio orta. Legatioque Imperatoris ad milites tumultuantes, & legationis refutatio. quomodo item vrbem cuftodierit re-giam. ac legatio exercitus ad Theodofium Mauri-cij filium,aut ipsum se,aut eius socerum proclama-turos se esse regem. quomodo etiam auditis hifce fufpectum Mauricius deinceps habuerit Germa-num,quasi fomitem autoremque tyrannidis:idco-que minæ, minarumque regiarum indicatio per Theodosium generum, & refugium Germani ad fanum Dei genitricis à Cyro exstructum. ac Ste-phani femiuiri, qui præfectus erat filiis Imperato-ris,ad Germanum,vt ex templo defcenderet, able-gatio irrita,& quomodo fuftibus fit cæfus Theodo-fius à patre filius,propterea quod foceri confilia vi-debatur
[notes in the right margin are cut off at the scan edge; only fragments such as "Ab", "De", "pro", "An" remain, mostly illegible]

page.notes: Right margin notes are cropped by the scan edge. Only 2 to 3 letter fragments are visible and none can be read in full, so they are not transcribed as words. Line 33 ("debatur") is right-aligned, the page's last line. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Paragraph breaks are not visible; the page is treated as one continuing paragraph.
